description:
Taehan Group CEO Park Shin-woo. A perfect man with looks, wealth, and ability.
He didn't put much importance on marriage, so it didn't matter who the other person was.
In that sense, Se-woon's eldest daughter Song Eun-seo was his best business partner.
Shin-woo gradually became attracted to her because she didn't cling or bother him...

"How was it when you kissed me?"
Shin-woo, who was only interested in business, was becoming more and more anxious for his marriage partner.
This was clearly a dangerous level.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8511790), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3093000611), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/_husband_), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000052751), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/59507873), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H044241824), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H044241824)
